query:
SELECT
            o.id,
            o.name AS "name!",
            o.slug,
            ob.plan_tier::text AS plan_tier,
            ob.subscription_status::text AS subscription_status,
            COALESCE(mc.member_count, 0) AS "member_count!",
            o.created_at AS "created_at!"
         FROM organizations o
         LEFT JOIN organization_billing ob ON ob.organization_id = o.id
         LEFT JOIN (
             SELECT organization_id, COUNT(*) AS member_count
             FROM organization_memberships
             WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'
             GROUP BY organization_id
         ) mc ON mc.organization_id = o.id
         ORDER BY o.created_at DESC
